verdict.rationale: The evidence covers only the branch layer of this story. Repository rulesets protect matching branches or tags by requiring pull requests, reviews and passing checks, or by blocking deletion and force pushes. CODEOWNERS approval enforces path-level review, and personal access tokens can be limited to granted permissions. Nothing documents role-based access control at the workspace/organization, project or repository level, so the multi-level granular model is mostly unevidenced. Missing for 10: workspace/organization-level roles and permissions, project-level access control, repository-level collaborator/team permission settings, independent or hands-on corroboration.
